description: Find a verified browser skill for a task on a website or web app (fill a form, file or look up a ticket, add to cart, export a report). Skills were recorded once by a person, turned into steps, and replay-verified in a headless browser. Returns up to 3 matches (limit: up to 5) above a confidence threshold, each with cid, name, site, site_kind (real site, or an Agentboard demo/mock site), params with examples, risk flags, steps that need human approval, how_to_run and a trust card computed from its signed runs; or matches: [] with a no-match message. check_workflow is the cheaper first call; neither runs anything. This HTTP endpoint does not offer run_skill; allowlisted skills can be tried with try_skill.

limit.description: max results: default 3, up to 5 (larger values return at most 5); only matches above the confidence threshold are returned, so there may be fewer

query.description: the task in plain words, e.g. "create a support ticket for dana@globex.com"

name: find_skill
title: Find a browser skill for a website task
